pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pManual FE source for starting or testing a small workshop.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Place the generator and use its crank interaction.$p2. Connect a permitted energy output to your first buffer or machine.$p3. Repeat until the full intended process batch is funded.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pA large late-game recipe can require far more FE than repeated cranking is convenient for. The server can change energy per use.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
